# alice-analyser

> An agent skill for working with ALICE analysers (and physicists in similar setups) on their own machine: a careful
> scientific coworker that works in small verified steps, never damages data or makes unrequested changes, keeps a
> project notebook, and knows the O2Physics / grid / Hyperloop / ROOT / offline-correction workflow and its pitfalls.

Start with SKILL.md. The references are read on demand, when the situation in the routing table of SKILL.md arises.

## Agent skill

- [SKILL.md](alice-analyser/SKILL.md): role, three analysis stages, rigour and momentum, what to do with and without asking, reproducibility, step loop, safety, verification, project structure
- [references/](alice-analyser/references/): toolbox, project structure, file conventions, analysis design (concept phase), collaboration, verification, safety, O2Physics, grid and Hyperloop, offline corrections, plotting, Python and ROOT, pitfalls, links, library development
- [assets/](alice-analyser/assets/): templates (project notebook, CLAUDE.md, study README, dry-run plan script, .gitignore)
- [scripts/](alice-analyser/scripts/): root_filecmp.C (exact ROOT file comparison), check_tools.sh (read-only environment report)
- alice-analyser.skill: the skill as a single file, attached to each release

## Repository

- [README.md](README.md): install and update
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what changed between versions
